name: v0.123.0
body:
## What

Nika 0.123 is the open-source reference release of Nika: the Rust engine, the `nika` command
line and its terminal workspace, and a TypeScript SDK (`@supernovae-st/nika` 0.123.0) that runs
`.nika` workflows from an application. After this release the project is maintained: security
fixes, bug fixes and compatibility. No hosted service is planned.

What it does:

- **Say it once, keep it as a file.** Describe an outcome in the terminal workspace (`nika`);
  Nika asks only for what is missing, writes a `.nika` workflow, checks it and, where it can,
  rehearses it on a copy of your files before you save or run anything.
- **Audited before it runs.** `nika check` reads the whole file first: the effects it may
  perform and nothing else (`permits:`), where secrets go, literal credentials, cost estimates
  and the lethal trifecta, and it names the repair where it knows one.
- **Metered and recorded while it runs.** `--max-cost-usd` caps a run, every run is recorded
  under `.nika/traces/`, and a run paused at a human gate resumes with the person's answer.
- **Scheduled by your own machine.** `nika arm` emits launchd or systemd units, with an env file
  for the provider keys a scheduled run needs.
- **Your choice of model.** The workflow file names its model, and Nika never substitutes
  another one silently.

Known limits are listed in plain words, each with a way around it:
[Known limits in 0.123](https://docs.nika.sh/changelog/known-limits). In short: a rehearsal
does not call models and replays only plain GETs of pages already observed; writing a workflow
with a large model can take minutes; the terminal mixes English and French lines; the VS Code
extension stays at 0.120; scheduled runs need your keys in an env file.

The changes since the 0.123.0-preview.1 prerelease follow; those from 0.122.0 to that
prerelease are in its own section of this changelog.

Read the [complete changes for v0.123.0](https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/blob/v0.123.0/CHANGELOG.md). The full changelog is preserved in this release's source tree; the pull request index follows below.

## Install

```sh
brew install supernovae-st/tap/nika          # macOS · Linux
curl -LsSf https://nika.sh/install.sh | sh   # script install
docker run --rm ghcr.io/supernovae-st/nika:0.123.0 --version
```

Tarballs below: macOS arm64 / x64 · Linux x64 / arm64, plus `SHA256SUMS`.

## Verify: three independent proofs

```sh
# 1 · checksum: the bytes you hold are the bytes CI hashed
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing     # macOS: shasum -a 256 -c

# 2 · attestation: GitHub-signed build provenance for this exact artifact
gh attestation verify nika-<platform>-0.123.0.tar.gz --repo supernovae-st/nika

# 3 · SLSA provenance: the intoto asset, verifiable offline
slsa-verifier verify-artifact nika-<platform>-0.123.0.tar.gz \
  --provenance-path multiple.intoto.jsonl \
  --source-uri github.com/supernovae-st/nika --source-tag v0.123.0
```

## Provenance

Built from tag `v0.123.0` by [`release.yml`](https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/blob/v0.123.0/.github/workflows/release.yml)
on GitHub-hosted runners. Provenance is published twice: GitHub's native
build attestation (proof 2) and the SLSA generator's `multiple.intoto.jsonl`
release asset (proof 3). The release itself is a claim on the
machine-verified timeline: https://nika.sh/timeline


## What's Changed
* fix(compile): keep protected paths out of rehearsal inputs by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1760
* feat(tui): restore native workspace inspection and compile receipts by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1763
* feat(session): deliver the intent-to-run workspace and resumable revisions by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1764
* docs(readme): label the retired planning archive by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1770
* feat(serve): observe, try and judge a remote compile like the cli by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1768
* fix: stop json and test runs holding stderr for the whole run by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1771
* docs(dx): align connectome rule with the pre-1.0 roadmap by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1772
* feat(session): converge authoring, save and run and the native workspace by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1774
* chore(release): prepare 0.123.0-preview.1 by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1777
* feat(workspace): integrate the session, compile and native lanes by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1779
* feat(workspace): integrate the agent-led session and native surface by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1780
* feat(workspace): integrate the acp-led conversation and run cancellation by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1781
* feat(workspace): integrate the session doors, compile and provider fixes by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1783
* feat(workspace): integrate the session trial, verifier and fidelity fixes by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1784
* feat(workspace): integrate reasoning state, verifier parts and session calls by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1785
* feat(workspace): integrate open choices, data bounds, low effort and members by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1787
* feat(workspace): integrate cut answers, prompt caching and the question policy by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1788
* chore(gates): raise the crate and file size walls to 25,000 and 2,500 lines by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1789
* feat(workspace): integrate the author forms, named refusals and LOC-EXEMPT parity by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1790
* ci(github): gate sensitive-path changes on a paired evaluation receipt by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1791
* feat(workspace): integrate behaviour proofs, builtin fixes, child rows and the d9b2d01 pin by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1793
* fix(nika-cli): judge every command a guarded shell line carries by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1798
* fix(nika-mcp): reach an allowlisted server's hosts through the egress proxy by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1799
* fix(nika-builtin): document every nika:date op that reads tz by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1800
* feat(workspace): converge the qa lane into main by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1808
* fix(workspace): say each line once and in the person's language by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1811
* fix(workspace): catch a jq unicode class before the run and read a day as data by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1812
* fix(workspace): rehearse the named folder, rerun over unnamed state, say what a refused turn did by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1813
* fix(workspace): rehearse a folder request for real and say a trial that binds nothing by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1814
* fix(workspace): close 0.123.0 with its finite list of fixes by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1816
* chore(release): prepare 0.123.0 by @ThibautMelen in https://github.com/supernovae-st/nika/pull/1818
